p.text: Real data plan. Creator wallet comes from the token's mint transaction. Past launches: every token that wallet created through the pump program. Outcomes: migrated if the curve completed, rugged if the creator sold more than half of their supply within an hour, otherwise faded or active. Peak market cap and holders from a price and holder source. Score weights: migration 30, rug history 25, dev holding 15, holder spread 10, peak strength 10, wallet transparency 10.
